hook: The $7 tool stuffing ratios actually need this year.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of flour being packed unevenly into a measuring cup, overflowing slightly, then leveled off inconsistently.
scenes.voiceover: Flour volume changes depending on how you scoop it — that's a real problem for pie crust ratios.

scenes.visual_prompt: The Ultrean digital kitchen scale on a counter, LCD display lit, price graphic overlay '$6.98 · 4.6 stars · 22,377 ratings'.
scenes.voiceover: This is the cheapest tool on my whole list, and it has the highest star average of anything I checked.

scenes.visual_prompt: Flour-dusted hand pressing the tare button on the scale, display resetting cleanly to zero.
scenes.voiceover: Reviewers say the display stays readable with wet or floury hands, and tare zeroes out between ingredients.

scenes.visual_prompt: Time-lapse of five different dry ingredients being added sequentially into one mixing bowl sitting on the scale, weight ticking up each time.
scenes.voiceover: That matters when a stuffing recipe calls for five dry ingredients added to the same bowl in sequence.

scenes.visual_prompt: Split shot: stuffing bread cubes weighed precisely on the scale versus the same bread cubes scooped unevenly into a measuring cup.
scenes.voiceover: Stuffing bread-to-liquid, pie crust flour-to-fat — these ratios are written in weight for a reason.

scenes.visual_prompt: Closing graphic: '5 tools, 1 Thanksgiving prep list' with small icons of all five compared products and a blog link callout.
scenes.on_screen_text: The lowest-risk buy on this list → link in bio.
scenes.voiceover: This is the lowest-risk purchase on the whole list — full breakdown is linked in bio.

caption: This is the cheapest thing on my Thanksgiving prep list at $6.98 — and it has the highest star rating of anything I checked. Stuffing and pie crust ratios are written in weight for a reason your measuring cups can't fix. Full comparison on the blog (link in bio).
